title: Settings
description: What this desk is connected to. Nothing on this page can be changed yet.

notice.text: API details are read from the Orion desk API when the page opens. Mail and models are not set up, so there is nothing to configure for them.

facts.Name: Orion desk API
facts.Access: Agent token, read-only. It is held by the web server and never sent to the browser.

panels.title: Language models
panels.body: No language model is connected. The desk does not draft, summarise or classify anything.

panels.title: Desk database
panels.body: Read through the Orion desk API, which opens it read-only. The web app has no database connection of its own.

panels.title: Customer mail
panels.body: No mail provider is connected. The desk cannot send or receive mail, and no reply leaves it. The rules mail must follow are in docs/communication-contract.md.
